meta.method: Assign each cause/effect node to the bechina-based package whose essential nature it shares. Polarity inherited from the receiving package.

assignments.node_id: כשמסתכל למעלה על כל הטובה, דהינו על השרש, שמשם נמשכין כל הטובות
assignments.node_text: כְּשֶׁמִּסְתַּכֵּל לְמַעְלָה עַל כָּל הַטּוֹבָה, דְּהַיְנוּ עַל הַשֹּׁרֶשׁ, שֶׁמִּשָּׁם נִמְשָׁכִין כָּל הַטּוֹבוֹת
assignments.partner_node: שלמות וגדלות השמחה הוא, מי שזוכה לשמח מכל הטובות ביחד
assignments.reason: This node's essential nature is looking upward at the root from which all goods flow. The text uses 'דהיינו על השרש' — 'that is, at the root' — directly identifying this act with the root itself. Package 1 contains both שרש and הסתכלות למעלה על כל הטובה as bechina-connected nodes. This cause-edge node is a verbose formulation of the same essential reality: the vantage point of the divine root.

assignments.node_id: שלמות וגדלות השמחה הוא, מי שזוכה לשמח מכל הטובות ביחד
assignments.node_text: שְׁלֵמוּת וְגַדְלוּת הַשִּׂמְחָה הוּא, מִי שֶׁזּוֹכֶה לִשְׂמֹחַ מִכָּל הַטּוֹבוֹת בְּיַחַד
assignments.partner_node: כשמסתכל למעלה על כל הטובה, דהינו על השרש, שמשם נמשכין כל הטובות
assignments.reason: This node's essential nature is perfect joy from all goods together — the defining state of Package 1. The packages file identifies שלמות וגדלות השמחה and שמחה מכל הטובות ביחד as bechina-connected nodes within Package 1 (the text equates them directly). This cause-edge node combines both phrases into a single verbose formulation. Its essential nature is unified joy at the root, squarely within Package 1.

This node's essential nature is inclusiveness — joy being included within its fellow joy. Package 2 contains both כלליות and שמחה בחברתה as bechina-connected nodes sharing this exact essential nature. This cause-edge node is a verbose formulation combining both package nodes into one phrase. It belongs to the domain of the inclusion mechanism, not to the root/unified-joy domain of Package 1.

This node's essential nature is the increasing light of joys — the luminous amplification that occurs through inclusion. Package 2 contains אור השמחה as a bechina node, which the packages file identifies as the same reality as התנוצצות seen from the outside. This cause-edge node ('the light of joys grows even more') is a verbal variant of אור השמחה in its amplified state. Its essential nature is light/luminosity of joy, belonging to Package 2.

This node's essential nature is mutual sparkling — the luminous interaction between included joys. Package 2 contains התנוצצות as a core bechina node, and this cause-edge node is a verbose formulation of the same concept ('sparkling that sparks from joy to its fellow'). The sparkling is the active, luminous dimension of the inclusion mechanism that defines Package 2.

This node's essential nature is the great increase of light — the amplified luminosity resulting from mutual sparkling. Package 2 contains אור השמחה as a bechina node. This cause-edge node ('the light greatly grows and increases') is another verbal variant of the same light-of-joy reality in its amplified state. Like its sibling node נגדל ביותר אור השמחות, its essential nature is the luminous dimension of unified joy, squarely within Package 2.
